items.statement: Stanford women's soccer plays away at Syracuse on Thursday 8 October 2026, 4:00 PM PT (Syracuse, NY), an ACC match. It is the only Stanford women's soccer fixture between 26 September and 15 October.

source.title: Women's Soccer 2026 schedule — Stanford Cardinal official athletics site

items.statement: Stanford women's soccer hosts California on Friday 16 October 2026, 7:00 PM PT at Stanford. It is the first home fixture since 20 September (a 26-day gap between home matches).

source.title: Women's Soccer 2026 schedule — Stanford Cardinal official athletics site

items.statement: Stanford drew 0–0 at SMU (Washburne Stadium, Dallas, TX) on Friday 25 September 2026, taking the season record to 8 wins, 2 losses, 2 draws; Stanford entered the week ranked No. 6 after beating No. 3 Wake Forest 2–0 on 20 September. The athlete's own part in the SMU match is not reported in the sources used.

source.title: Women's Soccer 2026 schedule and results; 'No. 6 Stanford Upends No. 3 Wake Forest' (20 Sep 2026) — Stanford Cardinal official athletics site

items.statement: Stanford Football hosts Georgia Tech on Saturday 26 September 2026 at Stanford Stadium, designated a 'Red Out' by Stanford Athletics — a campus-wide athletics occasion at the start of the window. No women's-soccer-specific event, award or ceremony is listed by Stanford Events between 26 September and 12 October.

source.title: Stanford Athletics events calendar — Stanford University Events

items.statement: The U.S. Women's National Team plays Spain in two friendlies inside the window: Saturday 10 October 2026 at Audi Field, Washington, DC, and Tuesday 13 October 2026 at Subaru Park, Chester, PA.

source.title: USWNT 2026 schedule, results, how to watch — NBC Sports (updated 9 Sep 2026)

items.statement: gorjana's own site currently leads with the hero 'Most loved. Most layered.' and new arrivals 'inspired by Old Hollywood glam'; its ongoing 'gorjana Sports Club' collection is described as 'created to celebrate and support women in sport, and to inspire the next generation of game changers', with a roster naming Pegula, Brink, Jovic, Betts, Nuneviller, Beason and Turner, an Arizona State roster and a 'College Roster' collective. No dated drop, campaign or event is announced on the site as of 26 September. In trade press (Marketing Brew, 6 May 2026) the brand said it prioritises long-term ambassador relationships over celebrity partnerships.

source.title: gorjana.com homepage and 'gorjana Sports Club' collection page (brand's own channels); Marketing Brew, 6 May 2026

items.statement: The Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix runs Friday 9 to Sunday 11 October 2026 at the Marina Bay Street Circuit; the race starts Sunday 11 October at 20:00 Singapore time.
